knowledge:
- key_parameters: sample_names=Path to a text file containing sample names (one per line, without .bam suffix) ;; bam_input=Path to the folder containing BAM and BAI files ;; target_regions=Path to a text file containing target regions (chr, start, end) or single positions (chr, position) ;; vcf_input=Path to a folder containing VCF files for the samples (optional) ;; output=Path to the folder where output text files will be saved ;; output_pictures=Path to the folder where output plots will be saved ;; known_file=Path to a tabix file containing known polymorphisms (e.g., dbSNP VCF) ;; genome=A BSgenome object representing the reference genome ;; MQ_threshold=Mapping quality threshold; reads below this are excluded ;; BQ_threshold=Base quality threshold; bases below this are excluded and counted separately ;; frequency_threshold=Frequency threshold below which minor variants are not reported in calling files ;; qual_lower_bound & qual_upper_bound=Bounds for mean quality visualization (darker/lighter bars) ;; marks=Numeric vector of relative frequencies to draw as horizontal lines in the plots ;; relative=Logical; whether to plot relative frequencies (TRUE) or absolute read counts (FALSE) ;; per_sample=Logical; whether to output one plot per sample (TRUE) or one plot per target position (FALSE) ;; output_list=For analyzeBasesPlotOnly, the list returned by analyzeBases
- alternatives: GATK or SAMtools (standard variant callers that apply complex filtration steps and do not report unfiltered reads or analyze non-variant positions) ;; Integrative Genomics Viewer (IGV) (good for manual visualization of alignments but time-consuming for multiple samples and lacks automated summing/visualization of base counts)
- when_to_use: Use when comparing different sequencing techniques (e.g., IonTorrent vs 454) at specific locations, investigating the background/unfiltered read counts at positions where a variant is expected but not called, or visualizing base composition, deletions, and insertions across multiple samples at specific target regions.
- pitfalls: Target regions file must contain either regions (chr, start, end) or single positions (chr, position); a mixture of both is not supported ;; BAM and BAI files must be in the same folder and their names must exactly match the sample names in the sample names file (without .bam suffix) ;; VCF files (if used) must have one file per sample, named matching the sample names ;; Requires specific packages like VariantAnnotation, Rsamtools, and a BSgenome package to be loaded.

workflows.name: complete_base_analysis
workflows.intent: Run the complete pipeline to analyze BAM files at target regions, output frequency and calling text files, and generate visual barplots.
input: SampleNames.txt (text file with sample names, one per line)
targetRegions.txt (text file with target regions or positions)
dbsnp_138.part.vcf.gz (optional tabix file of known polymorphisms)
workflows.stages: 1. Load reference genome ;; 2. Run analyzeBases to determine target positions, analyze reads (CIGAR strings, mapping/base qualities), sum up frequencies, report variants, and generate plots.
workflows.code:
library("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19")
ref_genome<-BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19

output1<-analyzeBases(sample_names=sample_file,
            bam_input=system.file("extdata",package="BBCAnalyzer"),
            target_regions=target_file,
            vcf_input="",
            output=system.file("extdata",package="BBCAnalyzer"),
            output_pictures="",
            known_file=system.file("extdata","dbsnp_138.part.vcf.gz",package="BBCAnalyzer"),
            genome=ref_genome,
            MQ_threshold=60,
            BQ_threshold=50,
            frequency_threshold=0.01,
            qual_lower_bound=58,
            qual_upper_bound=63,
            marks=c(0.01),
            relative=TRUE,
            per_sample=TRUE)

workflows.name: plot_only_analysis
workflows.intent: Regenerate or customize barplots using the pre-calculated analysis list from analyzeBases without re-running the BAM parsing.
input: output_list (R list object returned by analyzeBases)
dbsnp_138.part.vcf.gz (optional tabix file of known polymorphisms)
workflows.stages: 1. Run analyzeBasesPlotOnly using the output list from a previous analyzeBases run to generate customized plots (e.g., absolute counts, per-target plots).
workflows.code:
analyzeBasesPlotOnly(sample_names=sample_file,
            vcf_input=system.file("extdata",package="BBCAnalyzer"),
            output="",
            known_file=system.file("extdata","dbsnp_138.part.vcf.gz",package="BBCAnalyzer"),            
            output_list=output_list,
            qual_lower_bound=58,
            qual_upper_bound=63,
            marks=c(0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8,1),
            relative=FALSE,
            per_sample=FALSE)
